title.en: To the Tune Xijiangyue: Walking at Night on the Yellow Sand Road

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; punctuation is added at the source's own phrase breaks.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，标点依原文断句补加。

basis.en: Song dynasty lyric (ci); the author died in 1207.

note.en: Written in the 1180s, when Xin Qiji, soldier and statesman, had been retired to the countryside near Shangrao. It is a night walk told entirely through small sensations, moonlight, cicadas, rice scent, frogs, a few stars, a few drops of rain, and it ends with the relief of a remembered inn appearing round a bend. For a poet better known for heroic grief, it is unexpectedly happy.
note.zh: 作于 12 世纪 80 年代，辛弃疾这位将领兼政治家被罢官闲居上饶乡间之时。一次夜行，全用细小的感受写成：月光、蝉鸣、稻香、蛙声、几颗星、几点雨，最后转过溪桥，记忆里的茅店忽然出现，让人松一口气。对一位以悲壮著称的词人来说，这首词出人意料地快乐。

excerpt.orig: 七八個星天外，兩三點雨山前。
excerpt.en: Seven or eight stars beyond the sky, / two or three drops of rain before the hill.
excerpt.zh: 七八个星天外，两三点雨山前。
